headline: 100 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Second Flat Fire in OR, threatening 832 structures.

active_threats.name: Second Flat
active_threats.narrative: The Second Flat Fire in Harney County, OR has burned 105,854 acres and is 99% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **832 structures threatened**. 3 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 26 mph, sustained near 15) with humidity as low as 14%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over TX: Houston city, Pasadena city, Pearland city, College Station city, and The Woodlands CDP and 18 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 1% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
